title: hn6's acceptance list parses as one item: A2–A6 are unaddressable
description:
The epic's acceptance_criteria puts all six [A<n>] marks on one line, and the acceptance parser takes a mark only where a line begins with one (internal/acceptance/acceptance.go, Parse: one mark per line) — so hn6's done parses as the single item A1 with A2..A6 inside its prose, and per-item gate binding can only ever reach A1. Verified today: 6 marks in the text, one line-leading. Previously reported by run_3f034e683's attempt of this tick. The record is the tracker's to re-flow one [A<n>] item per line; no code change is needed.
